title: a16z Podcast: The Future of... You

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Humans have always wanted to enhance themselves -- from getting nutrition just-right to optimizing their performance.
reader_summary.overview: Humans have always wanted to enhance themselves -- from getting nutrition just-right to optimizing their performance, whether in sports or health or work. And food is a big part of all that. But our current systems of food production (and consumption) are far from efficient and sustainable let alone optimizable.

key_points.text: That's where a whole new generation of wearable/ bio-feedback, food and nutrition, food production, and performance enhancement/ "nootropics" companies come in.
How do these approaches move from the internet and online communities into the mainstream?
Or from the university lab to the field?
